channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Oil prices fall, stocks rally as US, Iran sign framework to end war
item.description: Brent crude drops as much as 1.6 percent, while key stock indices in Japan, South Korea and Taiwan climb.

item.title: Trump’s MoU with Iran draws backlash from some Republicans
item.description: Louisiana Senator Bill Cassidy blasts US-Iran MoU as 'worst foreign policy blunder in decades'.

item.title: Netanyahu under pressure in Israel after US-Iran agreement
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is facing mounting pressure after he was cut out of the US-Iran agreement.

item.title: US and Iran sign Memorandum of Understanding to end war
item.description: US President Donald Trump and Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian have reportedly signed a Memorandum of Understanding

item.title: Iran war live: Pakistan says MoU in effect after Trump, Pezeshkian signing
item.description: US officials say the deal includes an end to war in Lebanon and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Trump says it’s ‘unfair’ for Iran to lack ballistic missiles
item.description: President Donald Trump says it’s ‘unfair’ for Iran to lack ballistic missiles if other regional countries have them.

item.title: Diplomat confirms that US and Iran have signed MoU electronically
item.description: Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baghaei says the agreement has been finalised and signed with the US.

item.title: Huawei CFO’s admissions can be used at criminal trial, US judge rules
item.description: CFO Meng Wanzhou said in 2021 that Huawei illegally conducted business in Iran.

item.title: Read the US account of unreleased 14-point Iran ceasefire memorandum
item.description: US official gives clearest account yet of deal set to be signed by US and Iran Friday; Iran has not confirmed text.

item.title: What's in the US-Iran agreement?
item.description: The 14-paragraph memo includes an end to fighting, an agreement that Iran will never have a nuclear weapon, and a $300bn redevelopment package for Iran.
